core_obligations: The authors stratify root-reachable arc subsets by complementary reachability cuts, keep their exact cycle set fixed, and identify the two root-dependent strata through cut-arc binomial counts and balanced cut-flow equality. This proves root-independence at every arc cardinality for arbitrary fixed cycle sets in the original balanced directed multigraph. The acyclic, spanning-arborescence, orientation and feedback-arc cases are direct specializations and are not separately counted.
